method: direct balanced multivariate effect decomposition with ASCA-style SVD
primary_comparison: standardized Lab trace shares across regions
manova_note: Pillai, Wilks, Hotelling-Lawley, and Roy statistics are descriptive only; no formal p-values are reported.
limitations: Each phone x pH cell contains one physical strip.
The residual combines the three-way interaction with pure measurement/extraction error.
